verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a Marketing Emails API for creating, updating, and retrieving marketing emails and their statistics, plus UI-based segment sends and programmable email modules. Nothing shows a one-to-one transactional send endpoint for receipts, magic links, or notifications. Marketing-email management and bulk or scheduled sends are adjacent features, not transactional API sending.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends
